fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2026-06-01 states that a smartphone in a blue cover was allegedly snatched from the hand of the complainant at Nallur Park Main Street by a person who left quickly, on 2026-05-30 at approximately 17:40. The complaint was lodged by Kumaran Prakash (9000000476). The identity of the person involved remains unknown at this stage. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage and photographs.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Phone allegedly lifted during a brief distraction in a crowded area.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, CCTV, evening, photograph, main street
